text.text: A cream paper fox with ink-dot eyes and a tiny red scarf, standing upright on a sunny wooden windowsill beside a small yellow paper boat. Full body visible with clear margin above and below. Three-quarter front view, fixed framing, fox centered slightly left with the boat to its right. Soft natural daylight from the window, gentle warm shadows. Plain cream wall behind, smooth wooden sill surface. Handmade paper craft texture throughout, crisp folded edges, family-friendly still scene, no text, no extra objects.
